info.title: snapdragon-user-bff-api
info.description: User BFF API (/bff/user/**) — owner-scoped profile, home-guide preferences, federation-bundle cards, self-blocking, and instance-block recommendation. Every endpoint is keyed to the caller's Casdoor JWT subject.

tags.name: Mastodon proxy (D6)
tags.description: Owner-scoped Mastodon reverse-proxy; injects the server-held homeserver-native token. Ships dark behind app.hs-token.enabled.

tags.name: Home guide
tags.description: Per-user home/getting-started guide dismissal (owner = JWT subject).

tags.name: Media-cloak
tags.description: Poison-before-ingest media proxy (owner = JWT subject). Best-effort AI-cloak — 'AI-cloak applied', never 'protected' unless the round-trip survival gate passes.

tags.name: OIDC login callback
tags.description: Casdoor OIDC redirect callback. Ships dark behind app.bff.oidc.enabled; 503 when disabled.

tags.name: SSO auth
tags.description: Login / register / session surface, delegating to admin-bff internal. Ships dark behind app.bff.oidc.enabled.

tags.name: Profile
tags.description: The caller's OWN profile (owner = JWT subject). Password/email go to the Casdoor IdP.

tags.name: Self-block
tags.description: The caller's OWN blocks (owner = JWT subject) + instance-block recommendation.

tags.name: Notification preferences
tags.description: Per-category notification preferences (owner = JWT subject, domain-scoped). account-restriction is forced-on / un-silenceable.

tags.name: Cards
tags.description: The caller's OWN federation bundles (owner = JWT subject), via snapdragon-federation-api.

tags.name: User preferences
tags.description: Durable per-user UI preferences (owner = JWT subject, domain-scoped). Carries media.poison.default — the per-user AI-poison default the compose toggle persists.

tags.name: Matrix proxy (D6)
tags.description: Owner-scoped Matrix reverse-proxy; injects the server-held homeserver-native token. Ships dark behind app.hs-token.enabled.

tags.name: Self-silence
tags.description: Self-service visibility hide (owner = JWT subject). NOT a ban: no role/suspension/revocation.

tags.name: Account status
tags.description: Polling endpoint for the caller's own account status (roles, domain, silence).

tags.name: Notifications (in-app floor)
tags.description: The caller's OWN in-app notifications (owner = JWT subject, domain-scoped). The always-on in-app channel — read + mark-read only; the actions reconciler writes them.

tags.name: Connected clients
tags.description: The caller's OWN connected apps + device sessions (owner = JWT subject). Requires an external-client role.

tags.name: Notifications (internal deliver)
tags.description: SERVICE-PRINCIPAL ONLY in-app notification delivery (target taken from the body). Honours prefs (account-restriction forced-on) and is idempotent on the source event.

put.summary: Create/update my profile. The body's userId is ignored — the owner is the JWT subject; the vanity username is derived from the token.

get.summary: My durable preferences (server defaults merged in for unset keys).

put.summary: Upsert one of my durable preferences (returns the resolved view).

get.summary: My notification preferences (defaults merged in; account-restriction always enabled).

put.summary: Upsert one notification-category preference (returns the resolved view). account-restriction enabled=false is coerced to true.
Dismiss the named guide for me (PUT alias of /dismiss).

post.summary: Dismiss the named guide for me (idempotent).

delete.summary: Re-show (un-dismiss) the named guide for me.

get.summary: List versions of one of my cards by slug.

put.summary: Publish (create/update) a card bundle for a slug.
put.description: Body is the single entry file (octet-stream). federation-api content-hashes it, records a user_modules row under ME (forwarded JWT), and supersedes the prior version.

delete.summary: Delete one of my cards by slug.
delete.description: Proxies federation-api's owner-scoped DELETE: removes the caller's OWN current bundle for the slug (federation-api removes the storage version + supersedes the row). Owner-enforced upstream via the forwarded JWT (a non-owner gets 404 from federation-api).

post.summary: Email a mod/admin to reactivate me sooner (writes a self-silence-appeal request; NOT SMTP).
Activate my self-silence (hide me from others until expiresAt). I keep my own access.
Recommend an instance block (starts the USER->MOD->ADMIN chain via federation-api). Requires a platform role.
Change my Casdoor password (goes to the IdP, not the profile table).
Change my Casdoor email (goes to the IdP, not the profile table).
Mark one of MY notifications read (404 if not my own row).
Upload media through the cloak proxy (poison-then-forward).
post.description: Multipart: file (required) + platform (matrix|mastodon) + mode (glaze|nightshade|light|none, default from server) + roomId/description (passthrough). Returns the homeserver response verbatim + the server-owned cloak decision.

post.summary: Deliver one in-app notification to the target user (SERVICE-principal only; prefs honoured, account-restriction forced-on, idempotent on the source event).
Create a self-block (durable row + best-effort external push). Platform-role gated.
Email-provider registration: ensure the account. 503 when the SSO surface is dark.
Provider login: ensure the account and mint an opaque bff_ session (cookie + body). 503 when the SSO surface is dark.

get.summary: Caller's own account status — active roles, domain scope, and self-silence state.
My cloak decision for a media ref (badge polling), owner-scoped.
AI-cloak capability (worker backend + modes + ETA) for the shield state.
Is the named guide dismissed for me? (default guide = 'home')
List my connected apps + device sessions (owner = JWT subject). Requires an external-client role.
Read my card's current body (source) by slug — for Edit pre-fill.
get.description: Proxies federation-api's owner-scoped read-my-card-body so the WYSIWYG editor can RE-READ a card's current source to edit it. Owner-enforced upstream via the forwarded JWT (a non-owner gets 404 from federation-api). Returns the raw entry-file bytes.

get.summary: The caller's account view (from admin-bff). Authenticated. 503 when the SSO surface is dark.
Casdoor OIDC callback: validate state, exchange code (PKCE), provision account+session via admin-bff, mint the bff_ cookie, 302 to the UI. 503 when the OIDC surface is dark.

delete.summary: Revoke one of my connected clients (per-credential gateway key + best-effort homeserver delete + audit stamp).
Remove one of my self-blocks (scoped to me + id).
Revoke the caller's session (sessionOut) and expire the bff_ cookie. 503 when the SSO surface is dark.
